description: Run a SQL query (SELECT) against an IRIS namespace and return column names and row data. Use it for queries, including under the read-only governance preset, where iris_sql_execute is blocked. Supports parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection. Use maxRows to limit result set size (default: 1000). Returns {columns, rows, rowCount}; with countOnly it returns totalCount, the number of rows the query returns, and transfers no rows. Governance: this tool is enabled by default; it is disabled when an operator explicitly disables iris_sql_execute, unless iris_sql_query is set explicitly. This tool is statement-level read-only, not side-effect-free: only SELECT runs, every other statement (CALL included) is refused with SQL_READ_ONLY before it runs, and the query runs inside a transaction that is always rolled back. The transaction undoes SQL changes and journaled global sets made by functions and triggers, but not $INCREMENT/$SEQUENCE counters (row ID counters included), process-private or IRISTEMP globals, changes made with %NOJOURN by a function, procedure or trigger the statement runs, work that parallel query worker processes do (%PARALLEL), JOB or device output, other external effects, or a function, procedure or trigger that starts, commits or rolls back a transaction (reported as an error when the transaction level the tool opened has changed, which a commit followed by a new TSTART does not show; some changes may be saved). An operator may set IRIS_SQL_MAX_ROWS (a ceiling on the number of rows returned — the response carries rowsCapped: true when it clamps the caller's request; it bounds the returned row count post-fetch, not the server-side result set or transfer) and/or IRIS_SQL_TIMEOUT (per-request timeout in seconds) as environment variables; both are opt-in and unset by default.

countOnly.description: Return only totalCount, the number of rows the query returns, and transfer no rows (default: false)

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return as an integer (default: 1000)

parameters.description: Parameterized query values as a JSON array matching ? placeholders in the query (e.g., ["MyApp."] for a single parameter)

query.description: SQL query to run (a SELECT, e.g., 'SELECT Name FROM %Dictionary.ClassDefinition WHERE Name %STARTSWITH ?')

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_sql_query
title: Query SQL
